memories.title: A little cat-like
memories.text: She absolutely loves all animals, especially cats. Maybe that's why her face looks a bit like a cat's—haha.

memories.title: Croissants over regular bread
memories.text: She likes bread too, but what she likes best are pastries—croissants—because she says regular bread is too dry, haha.

memories.title: Chocolate is the favorite
memories.text: The flavor she likes the most is chocolate.

memories.title: A seafood kind of person
memories.text: She likes seafood and probably enjoys almost any food—except things like chicken or beef liver and gizzards, eggplant, and beef tendon; basically, anything with a mushy texture.

memories.title: Her ever-growing drink list
memories.text: Some drinks she likes: Kopi Tuku less sugar; Kopi Fore Berry Manuka with more ice; Kopi Kenangan Spanish latte; Point Coffee; Teazzi less sugar with 30% ice; Boost All Berry Bang; Kopi Susu Jago; Kopi Sobat Nako; and iced sweet tea when eating out. She's tried many because she likes exploring flavors.

memories.title: The matcha exception
memories.text: She doesn't like matcha. Haha, wimpy.
